notes: Drain offer.queued before the coordinated switch, then switch every customer and notifier instance together. This prevents an old customer/notifier pair from producing sends after the explicit-opt-in rule is active and prevents old notifier instances from bypassing the daily cap while new instances are live. The additive capped and offer_customer_lock tables are retained. Roll back both services together; never run the new customer with an old notifier or the new notifier with an old customer.
